purpose: Build a price-blind Form 4 research census before testing one insider-behavior hypothesis.

source.as_filed_policy: Retain amendments as separate later public observations; never rewrite an earlier filing in place.

universe.discovery_role: Existing 51 equities are parser and feature-development context only.
universe.oos_role: Eligible current S&P 500 constituents in independent_universe_v1.csv after excluding the existing 51 equities.
universe.oos_claim_boundary: Hypothesis-specific current-constituent robustness only; not blind and not survivorship safe.
universe.zero_filing_policy: A zero-filing issuer-quarter is observed zero when the official quarterly ZIP is complete, not missing data.

point_in_time.source_time: SEC filing date from the official bulk SUBMISSION table.
point_in_time.tradable_time: First available price session strictly after filing date.
point_in_time.acceptance_time_limitation: The official flattened data omits acceptance timestamps, so same-day action is forbidden.

normalization.aff10b5one_policy: Use the filed checkbox when present; otherwise UNKNOWN. Footnotes may add explicit TRUE evidence but may not infer FALSE.

evidence_basis.claim: SEC quarterly files are flattened as-filed ownership XML and include amendments and footnotes.
P and S mean open-market or private purchase/sale, so venue must not be invented.
Insider purchases have historically been more informative than sales.
Routine trades are materially less informative than opportunistic trades.
